verdict.rationale: ReadMe's own Docs Audit finds broken links across every page, and Reviews can run the AI Linter on changes kept in branches before they go live, so there is a first-party pre-publish check. The evidence never shows these checks running in a CI pipeline or validating configuration. The rdme CLI exists, but no validation command is evidenced. Missing for 10: CI-pipeline integration of the checks, validation of invalid configuration or OpenAPI files, a documented build-failing gate on broken links, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, CI validation catches broken links and invalid configuration before the site publishes

citations.quote: Docs Audit runs your Linter rules against every page in your project in a single pass, so you can find outdated content, broken links, and style inconsistencies across your entire site
Reviews allow you to check your changes for issues with the AI Linter or get approval from a teammate.
Branches allow admins to save changes across pages without them going live immediately.
